user_model_brief: Single-user Meta-internal tool. PostgreSQL/asyncpg, repository pattern, Alembic. Config DB-authoritative (ADR 0055). React19+Vite+TanStack. Prefers maximum fidelity/thoroughness over lower effort (see feedback_max_fidelity_preference).
settled_decisions: S4 capture everything incl. memory subservice
S6 one row/call, subcalls nested JSONB
S7 API field names match UI SystemStatus.tsx
S9 memory subservice full fidelity (wrap Graphiti)

branches.topic: capture mechanism + context threading + async write

decisions.question: capture fidelity
decisions.answer: full bodies+context via contextvars + extended record_plugboard_call

decisions.question: retention
decisions.answer: 28d configurable + optional row cap, daily sweep

decisions.question: memory subservice
decisions.answer: full fidelity, wrap Graphiti, write to workbench DSN

decisions.question: row granularity
decisions.answer: one row/call, subcalls nested; single=one subcall

decisions.question: sync->async write
decisions.answer: bounded queue + writer task, drop on full/error

decisions.question: detail payload
decisions.answer: lazy on click; list rows summary only

decisions.question: stages added to UI
decisions.answer: extract, scoring, memory added to LLM_STAGE_TONE

passes.judge_rationale: Baseline artifacts (spec, 6 ADRs, plan) from the normal run.

Ungated the plugboard sink from metrics.enabled (would capture zero rows when metrics.enabled=false), fixed temperature non-null TS contract, made /{id} 404 explicit, added CONTEXT.md glossary; judge spotted 1 open gap (temperature coalesce not propagated to plan Task 8).
Closed the open gap — propagated temperature coalesce + /{id} contract into plan Task 8 + added a temperature-type test assertion (counted material).
Fixed dangling/incorrect ADR citations in the spec (API typing mis-cited 0059; memory column-contract mis-cited 0058 -> 0059; response_model -> house convention).
Zero material edits; all five checks pass (no UNRESOLVED, ADR citations correct, field names consistent spec<->plan<->UI, every File-Change has a plan task, numeric defaults consistent).
